recipe.name: Spice Route
recipe.description: Crisp herbal botanicals from the gin blend seamlessly with zesty lime and a warming, aromatic spice syrup, lengthened with crisp soda.
steps: Juice the lime to yield 25 ml of fresh juice.
Add the gin, house-made spice syrup, and lime juice to a cocktail shaker filled with ice.
Strain the mixture into a highball glass filled with fresh ice cubes.
Top up with soda and gently stir to integrate.
recipe.garnish: Lime wheel and a star anise
